answer: An identity must be at least 7 epochs old on the vault ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. Because the age is read from the ridge checkpoint rather than self-declared, the ripple audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. Running a farm therefore means funding each alias through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
